name: io.github.whosman/curatormatch
title: Curator Match
description: Find Steam curators by name or by the games they covered, with signs of key reselling.

tools.name: get_curator_list_link
tools.description: Builds a Curator Match link for a game developer who wants Steam curators to send review keys to. Use it when a developer asks which curators to contact for their game, wants an outreach or key list, or is planning a launch or Next Fest. Send one to five games similar to theirs, by name or app id. The link opens Curator Match with those games filled in: the ranked curators who covered them, their warning signs and the send list for Curator Connect. Also returns what the free and paid plans include. Creates nothing and needs no account.

games.description: One to five Steam games similar to the developer's game: names as the store shows them ("Hades"), app ids ("1145360") or store links.

tools.name: find_curators_for_games
tools.description: The Steam curators who posted about one to five games, ranked by how many they covered, how recently and how active they are, with curators that show several warning signs left out. Use it when a developer names games like theirs and asks which curators covered them. Send game names or app ids. Returns the top matches with followers, matched games and warning signs, how many more match, and a link to the full ranked list.

games.description: One to five Steam games similar to the developer's game: names as the store shows them ("Hades"), app ids ("1145360") or store links.

appids.description: The same as games, as Steam app ids. Send games or appids.

tools.name: search_curators
tools.description: Find Steam curators by name. Use it when someone names a curator (for example one that emailed them asking for a key) and you need its Curator Match id. Matching ignores case, spacing and punctuation, and a part of the name is enough. A Steam curator link or id also works. Returns up to ten curators, biggest first, with followers, warning level and links.

name.description: The curator's name or part of it, such as "PC Gamer" or "shotgun". A Steam curator link or id also works.

tools.name: get_curator
tools.description: One Steam curator in detail: followers and the change over the last month, the share of high-value followers, how often it posts, its recent posts, and each warning sign with its reason. Use it before a developer sends a key to a curator, or to check a curator that asked for one. Takes the curator id, or its Steam or Curator Match link. Warning signs are patterns, not proof.

id.description: The curator id (the number in its Steam curator link), or the link itself.
